sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe1 statistics window start register (DCMIPP_P1STSTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.51 "DCMIPP Pipe1 statistics window start register (DCMIPP_P1STSTR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1940.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x85C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:16 VSTART[11:0]: Vertical start, from 0 to 4094 pixels high
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 HSTART[11:0]: Horizontal start, from 0 to 4094 pixels wide
